questions.question: What mission does Yaga give his students?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Their mission is to protect and escort the Star Plasma Vessel to Jujutsu High so they can merge with Master Tengen and reset their immortality cursed technique in two days on the full moon

questions.question: What happens to the Star Plasma Vessel's location?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: The location of the Star Plasma Vessel has been leaked and two groups are known to be targeting her

questions.question: How does Kokun try to kill Riko?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Q soldier, Kokun, tosses the vessel, Riko Amanai, out to plummet to her death

questions.question: When do Satoru and Suguru arrive?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Satoru and Suguru arrive just as the explosion goes off, with the former slightly concerned they might be too late

questions.question: How does Suguru rescue Riko?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Suguru uses a sting-ray like curse with the ability to fly to catch the girl, rescuing her from near death

questions.question: How does Satoru stop the knives?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: He activates the Infinity, stopping all the knives in their tracks instantly

questions.question: What does Bayer recognize about Satoru?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Q soldier, Bayer recognizes Satoru and his technique, admitting he knows the sorcerer is famous

questions.question: How does Suguru defeat Kokun?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Suguru makes short work of Kokun, trapping him in a fungus curse that constantly attempts to kiss him while he's immobilized

questions.question: How does Suguru prove Bayer was defeated?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Suguru shows him a picture of Bayer defeated on his phone

questions.question: What happens to Q after the defeat?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: After Q's strongest soldier suffers defeat, the organization disbands

questions.question: Who do they hire to kill the vessel?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: pay Toji Zenin to take care of the job since the Star Religious Group doesn't have the power to fight themselves

questions.question: What does Toji accept?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo & Suguru Geto vs. Bayer & Kokun

answer.item: Toji accepts the job to assassinate the Star Plasma Vessel
